q1.text: Delivered exactly on time, and the quality is better than the photos. The kitchen looks precisely like the 3D design.

q2.text: One team handled everything from measurement to installation. The process was calm and transparent.
q2.author: G. M. — Saburtalo

q3.text: They built the full interior for our café — we opened without a day of delay.
q3.author: T. B. — Vera

pricing.a: We quote after an on-site measurement and an agreed design. The price is fixed in writing and never changes.

timeline.a: Production takes 3–5 weeks on average after design approval. Installation usually takes 1–3 days.

materials.q: What materials do you use, and is there a warranty?
materials.a: We work with European MDF and solid wood; hardware is Blum and Häfele. Every piece we build is covered by a warranty.

commercial.a: Yes — offices, cafés, and shops, from single pieces to complete turnkey fit-outs.

process.q: How does the process work from start to finish?
process.a: First a site visit and measurement, then a 3D design you approve, then production in our workshop and installation by our own team. One contact person keeps you informed at every stage — most projects need [FILL: number] visits in total.

warranty.q: What warranty do you give on finished furniture?
warranty.a: Every piece we install carries a [FILL: number]-year warranty covering the construction and the installation. Hardware is covered by the manufacturers' own warranties, and we keep servicing what we build after the warranty ends.

area.q: Where do you work — Tbilisi only?
area.a: Our workshop is in Tbilisi and most projects are within the city. We also take on projects in [FILL: other cities/regions, e.g. Batumi, Rustavi] — travel and delivery for out-of-town work are agreed in the quote.

audio.label: Listen
audio.transcript: Welcome to Kencho Group. We're a small team in Tbilisi that designs, builds, and installs custom furniture — all under one roof. Every project begins in your space: we visit, we measure, and we listen to how you live. Our designers then draw your interior in 3D, so you see the result before we cut a single board. In our own workshop, your kitchen, wardrobe, or complete interior takes shape within three to five weeks — European materials, precise joinery, and a warranty on everything we make. Then we arrive, install cleanly, and hand over a finished space. If you're thinking about a project of your own, write to us on WhatsApp. The measurement is free.
